sources.summary: Racine Carrée draws its identity from the convergence of a structured approach – inspired by the spatial permutations of a Rubik's Cube – and a sensitive connection to the natural landscape. The project is based on the rigorous development of an orderly facade grid, set in tension with the site's inherent qualities. It thus expresses a fundamental conceptual duality between geometric rationality and integration into the landscape.
